best_idea: Add a single O(n) scan that early-outs for already-sorted and reverse-sorted inputs before running the radix passes, so the sorted/reverse benchmark distributions skip nearly all work.

best_lineage.idea: Replace the O(n log n) merge sort with a four-pass LSD radix sort (8-bit digits via counting sort with skip of constant-digit passes), which gives linear-time sorting and should substantially cut CPU time on random data.
